brief: Sports Genome - 50-exercise data and engine integration (6 Oct 2026)
rule: A pair is mapped only when both frames show the record's stated setup (equipment, stance, sides, range). A same-named pair that shows a different setup is rejected; a record with no such pair keeps the equipment placeholder. Never another exercise's photo.
